recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Avoid editing the source spreadsheets solely to remove the visible string/uri type cells unless the active generator contract changes; current generated semantics and narrative already satisfy the seed. Handle Resource.id/Patient.id fhir-type questions under their own unresolved tracker if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-12060 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to remove ordinary type-code treatment from Element.id and Extension.url and use compiler-magic type metadata so those XML-attribute/simple values are not treated as FHIR primitive Elements with child id/extension content.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn commit e8c22a3727455852300b359fe317824ad3ae2224, message GF#12060 and svn revision 14528, which special-cased Element.id and Extension.url in generation/tooling rather than simply deleting the visible spreadsheet type cells.
additional_context: Later FHIR-I decisions support the current representation: FHIR-31656 added explicit no-extensions prose for Extension.url and Element.id; FHIR-25274 documented the FHIRPath System.String plus structuredefinition-fhir-type mechanism; FHIR-38684 and FHIR-41183 corrected Element.id-derived fhir-type metadata to string; FHIR-45989 confirmed Element.id is fhir-type string while Resource.id is intentionally fhir-type id. The unresolved FHIR-57383 Resource.id/Patient.id regression is separate from this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source includes Element and Extension as infrastructure definitions, current prose explains that Extension.url/Element.id cannot have extensions and how System.String plus structuredefinition-fhir-type works, and build.fhir.org shows Element.id and Extension.url as xmlAttr fields with type code http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.String and fhir-type values string and uri.
